title: Soil Science
description: Soil is alive: humus and charcoal hold nutrients on their charged surfaces, and fungi thread through the roots to trade minerals for sugar. A root takes nutrients up fast while they are scarce and no faster once its carriers are all busy. Unlocks Biochar, Humus, Mycorrhizal Inoculant and Living Soil.

puzzle.goal: A root's carriers take a nutrient up at a rate that rises with its concentration c and levels off at a maximum V, reaching half of it at c = K (Michaelis-Menten uptake). Write v, the uptake rate.
puzzle.name: Nutrient uptake
puzzle.ask: Find v in µmol/g·h: V = @{V}, K = @{K} µM, c = @{c} µM.
puzzle.method: Carriers bind and release: at steady state the busy fraction is c/(K + c).
